disclosure:
Method. This update was produced by the desk's report engine: the company tracker pulled the live PitchBook profile and news record on August 10, 2026, merged them into the canonical company store under freeze-on-conflict rules, recomputed derived metrics, and generated the tracker tables in Section 2 directly from the store at build time. Prose sections were composed against the measured house style profile and the company-update template; every load-bearing figure carries a source of kind and date in text. Source tiers follow the house convention: T1 regulatory filings, T2 company announcements and PitchBook records, T3 press reports, with estimates labeled at the point of use.

Standing constraints. Unclosed financings, including the July 17 term sheet, never anchor the base case; they are analyzed as forward signals. Capital-efficiency denominators are equity-only. PitchBook TTM revenue fields are forward-window projections and are not used as run-rate sources. The quality-valuation coefficient is embargoed; the per-point spread is its only cleared expression.

This document is not investment advice. Figures dated before August 10, 2026 are the latest available disclosures as of the run date; stale operating metrics are flagged with their vintage in Section 2.
